selection.policy: baseline corpus plus owner-accepted human-review sample

foldPolicy: identical StratifiedGroupKFold splits; scenario families never cross train/test within a fold

hashContract.normalization: lowercase NFKD, remove combining marks, collapse whitespace
hashContract.features: word unigrams, word bigrams, character 3-5 grams

messages.text: Párate en la esquina y me dices quién pasa
Eh este hay jale para ti
Mi mamá prepara tacos mientras juego

limitations: The bakeoff uses only 185 review-eligible synthetic/curated conversations.
Grouped CV is conservative but is not an independent regional or production holdout.
Winning this bakeoff does not authorize promotion beyond shadow mode.
